curated.tagline: Command Skyrim NPCs like an RTS, simulated by 0 A.D. over a local WebSocket
curated.description: 0 A.D. runs the simulation headless, a Python host mirrors it over a local WebSocket, and an SKSE plugin renders it as real Skyrim actors from a top-down command camera. Built around the Age of Skyrim mod. Private repository, work in progress.
highlights: Two-process design: headless 0 A.D. plus a Python host, mirrored to the game over WebSocket
SKSE plugin with an RTS camera, box selection, orders and a command grid
Written message protocol between host and plugin
curated.architecture: 0 A.D. (headless) ↔ Python host (RL HTTP) ↔ WebSocket ↔ SKSE plugin → Skyrim NPCs

showcase.whatItIs: A mod that lets you command Skyrim NPCs like an RTS. 0 A.D. owns economy, pathing and combat; Skyrim is the renderer and input device.
showcase.whoItsFor: Skyrim Special Edition players; it is built around the Age of Skyrim mod.
showcase.whatLukeBuilt: The Python bridge host that mirrors the 0 A.D. simulation, the SKSE plugin that renders it as Skyrim actors with a top-down camera, selection, orders and a command grid, and the WebSocket protocol between them.
showcase.status: Work in progress, Windows only. The host is covered by offline tests; the plugin UI has not had a long human playtest.
